Cut off marks represent the minimum score a candidate must obtain in an examination to qualify for the next round of selection — which could be a physical test, skill test, document verification, or final appointment. Cut off marks are determined after the examination is conducted and depend on several factors including the total number of candidates, number of vacancies, difficulty level of the exam, and the reservation policy applicable for each category.
